pipelines.name: mymo_daily_limit_data_collection
pipelines.description: Daily (T-1) pipeline collecting 2 MyMo daily-limit files from FTP: mymo_transaction_limit (log of transactions blocked due to limit restrictions) and mymo_set_limit (log of limit-adjustment activity). Validates checksums, stores raw copies to the HDFS raw zone, copies them to the HDFS gold_safe zone (no separate cleansed zone for this pipeline), then loads into Hive (prod_safe_mymo.mymo_transaction_limit, prod_safe_mymo.mymo_set_limit) via a Hive loader step.
